TransferLocalBlobSpec is the input specification for the

globalAccessPolicy.description:
GlobalAccessPolicy controls whether global access references are added to local blobs
in an OCI repository. If not set (empty), global access is never added.
Set to "auto" to auto-detect based on the storage backend. Only OCI repositories support "auto".

Experimental: This policy is carried over from OCM v1 for backwards compatibility.
Its future availability is being evaluated by the community.

repository.description: Repository is the OCI or CTF repository specification the local blob is added to.

ocm.software.open-component-model.bindin.title: GlobalAccessPolicy
ocm.software.open-component-model.bindin.description:
GlobalAccessPolicy defines how global access references are handled when adding local blobs.
The zero value (empty string) maps to never adding global access, discouraging reliance on
global access references.

oneOf.description:
GlobalAccessPolicyNever suppresses global access on all local blobs, even when the storage
backend is globally reachable. This is the default (zero value) to discourage reliance on
global access references.

GlobalAccessPolicyAuto auto-detects based on the storage backend. Global access is only
added when the storage backend is globally reachable (e.g. a remote OCI registry).

Experimental: This policy is carried over from OCM v1 for backwards compatibility.
Its future availability is being evaluated by the community.

digest.description:
Digest optionally pins the component version to the OCI digest ("<algorithm>:<hex>") of the
image index or manifest it is stored as. The resource is then read from that artifact
instead of from the one the version tag resolves to.

repository.description: Repository is the OCI or CTF repository specification holding the component version.

Must match a resource in the component descriptor.
